    Wei Pan (潘炜)

    I am an undergraduate student at Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech), supervised by Prof. Boyu Zhou. I was also a visiting student at UC Berkeley (25 Fall). Currently I am a research intern at Wuji. My goal is to build robust, generalizable and useful robotic systems. Now I am focusing on (a) Tactile-Adaptive Robot Dexterity, (b) Pre-trained friendly bi-dexterous robotic system design.
